integrity: Exact discriminant/vertex proof covers all positive real separations and pulse ratios; 3,999 randomized tests are supporting checks only. Self-review is not independent validation. Historical coverage remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Ideal linear, homogeneous three-reservoir cascade with exactly two instantaneous positive impulses; mathematical local-maximum count, not empirical flood magnitude or noise-robust inference. No finite-width-rainfall or nonlinear-routing conclusion.
title: A reentrant two-peak phase diagram for unequal storms in the three-reservoir Nash cascade
